entities.summary: Rzeszów University of Technology, also known as Rzeszów Polytechnic or Ignacy Łukasiewicz University of Technology, is a state-run institution of higher education in Rzeszów, Poland. According to international ranking by the Webometrics Ranking of World Universities published by the Spanish institute Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas, the university was ranked 14th among the technical universities in Poland and, internationally, at number 1,173 among all listed universities.
